title: Integrating the evidence for a terrestrial carbon sink caused by increasing atmospheric CO 2

extraction_issues.quote: Tree-ring analysis at CO2-springs in Italy (two sites) suggests that eCO2 increased Quercus ilex tree ring-width (a proxy for wood BP) initially (βapp = 0.49-0.81)
extraction_issues.reason: 此处描述的是直接受 eCO₂ 影响的 CO₂ 温泉实验，按文中定义应使用 βdir 而非 βapp；但原文如此，存疑。

extraction_issues.quote: 14 methods to estimate GPP from satellite-based fAPAR resulted in wide-ranging iCO2 sensitivities
extraction_issues.reason: “14 methods”可能是“1-4 methods”或类似表述被解析为“14”，但无强证据，存疑。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: Meta-analysis found eCO2 increased fine-root BP across experiments (βdir,fut = 0.56) (βdir,fut = 0.56), in forests (βdir,fut = 0.92), and to a lesser degree in grasslands (βdir,fut = 0.18)
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 括号内 (βdir,fut = 0.56) 出现两次，疑为文本抽取时重复，原文可能只出现一次。
